correctness.rationale: The constant-term freshman-dream factorization gives T_{5m+a}=w_a T_m (mod 5), w=(1,1,3,2,4), hence all residues nonzero. Conditioning on the lowest digit gives ratio carry recursion; h=1 has a contraction and uniform fixed point; all h>=2 descend to smaller lags. For character pairs with chi psi!=1, F_k(0)=1 and the h=1 recurrence has one unit-modulus self-loop, yielding O_h(k) by induction on h; chi psi=1 ratios have O_h(1) carry coupling error. Fourier inversion and aligned base-five block decomposition yield the count O_h(log^2 N). Exact adjacent recurrences give all 16 P_k cells, independently checked through k=7. The finite check corroborates the all-lag mathematical derivation, not replaces it.
